extracted.notes:
The W&L Department of Theater, Dance and Film Studies Presents a romantic comedy by John Cariani set in the remote town of Almost, Maine, where the town's residents meet and fall in and out of love in unexpected and hilarious ways.

## Showtimes

- Wednesday–Friday, November 11, 12, 13, 2026 at 7:30 p.m.
- Saturday, November 14, 2026 at 2 p.m.

## Tickets

Tickets are required. General Public $18; Senior $16; W&L Faculty/Staff $14; W&L Student/Student $8. Taxes and processing fees included in ticket pricing.

Presented by arrangement with Concord Theatricals on behalf of Dramatists Play Service.
